name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Restores action/skill patch fields with controlled field-specific limits and patches the official 0.4.5 extra tier tables.
notes: Action/skill patch fields are restored from the r13 1.0..1.0 lock to controlled limits: 80%..120%, 85%..115%, 90%..110%, and ultimate cooldown 66.7%..150%.
Official 0.4.5 extra patch-generation buff/nerf tier tables are patched so weak/normal nerfs are not treated as buff-side tiers.
Apply now patches TeamfightManager2.exe first, then bundle.game_data, to avoid half-upgraded action-field states.
